test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Starting from a point X, Shekhar walks 70 m towards the north. Then, he takes a left turn and walks 150 m. Then, he takes a left turn and walks 70 m. Finally, he takes a left turn and walks 90 m to reach point Y. How far and in which direction is point X from point Y?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
From the given information:

Starting from a point X, Shekhar walks 70 m towards the north. Then, he takes a left turn and walks 150 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/946ea8249027af66094049f68582709883972e3ea86cf3dd5f1d0ef8209cc26b.png] 

Now, takes a left turn and walks 70 m. 

And Finally, he takes a left turn and walks 90 m to reach point Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a5be4af2b4216a20bf6c74d74ffd0f9b69ddc709cf603841ce10d27a3d5fc2a.png] 

So, Distance from Y to X = 150 -90 = 60m.

Here, Point **X is 60 m towards the east of Y.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
